reason:
Updated UART_Receive_IT to prevent calling HAL_UARTEx_RxEventCallback which was causing exceptional loops. The function now:
1. Never calls HAL_UARTEx_RxEventCallback, even for IDLE reception mode
2. Always calls the standard receive complete callback (HAL_UART_RxCpltCallback or registered equivalent)
3. Maintains all other functionality (data reading, state updates, etc.)
4. This is consistent with the changes made to HAL_UART_IRQHandler which also avoids calling HAL_UARTEx_RxEventCallback
This should help prevent the exceptional loop that was occurring when HAL_UARTEx_RxEventCallback was being called.
